now.title: Marvel Zombies
now.text: In the world Wanda remakes, Riri breaks into the illusion to warn Kamala that none of it is real.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Breaks into the illusion to warn Kamala the new world is fake.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Trapped in an illusion Riri tries to break.

changes.evidence: Riri hacking into Wanda's remade world to tell Kamala it is not real happens at the very end of episode 4, the finale. The bare series title lets it show from episode 1.

now.title: The Punisher S2#12
now.text: Krista Dumont is Billy Russo's therapist, who falls for him and helps him rebuild his strength. She takes Billy's side against Frank Castle and manipulates Dinah Madani for information on him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Billy Russo's therapist and lover, who takes Billy's side against Frank.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Billy's enemy, whom Krista works against by pumping Madani for information.

changes.evidence: Krista takes Billy's side against Frank from S2#8-9 and pumps Madani for information on the Punisher in S2#10 'The Dark Hearts of Men'. S2#12 is where Madani finds her out and pushes her out a window, which the stage does not describe.

now.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
now.text: Jean Grey is a telepath who takes control of the Hulk and others. Frank joins Spider-Man to stop her.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Telepath controlling the Hulk and others. Frank joins Spider-Man to stop her.

proposed.text: Jean Grey, a telepath attacking Damage Control, takes control of Frank to open a vault. Frank later shoots at her from a distance, and Spider-Man shields her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A telepath who takes control of Frank. He later shoots at her.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A vigilante Jean takes control of, who later shoots at her.

changes.evidence: In the film Jean possesses Castle to open a vault hiding DODC agents, and at the end Castle shoots at Jean from a distance after Peter has reconciled with her; Peter shields her and is badly hurt. Frank never teams with Spider-Man to stop her; he hides MJ, then acts against Spider-Man's wishes. The current text and cards miss that she controls Frank himself.

now.title: What If...?#9
now.text: Pepper suspects Killmonger in Tony's and Rhodey's deaths and teams up with Shuri to expose him. They close in on him in Wakanda.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Doubts Killmonger and hunts him down.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Killed Tony. Pepper sets out to expose him.

proposed.title: What If...?#6
proposed.text: Pepper suspects Killmonger in Tony's and Rhodey's deaths. Shuri brings her proof, and the two team up to expose him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Doubts Killmonger and teams up with Shuri to expose him.

changes.evidence: Pepper's suspicion and her alliance with Shuri both happen in S1E6 'What If... Killmonger Rescued Tony Stark?' (#6). Only the raid on the empty throne room is in #9, where the Watcher has already taken Killmonger, so the stage belongs at #6, and 'close in on him' and 'hunts him down' come from #9 and would spoil it.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
now.text: Jemma has saved May's life before, curing her after a ghost's touch nearly kills her. When Izel fatally wounds May, Jemma freezes her in a cryo chamber to keep her alive.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend Jemma has saved before and freezes to keep alive.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend who saved May once and freezes her to save her life.

proposed.text: Jemma has saved May's life before, curing her after a ghost's touch nearly kills her. When Sarge fatally stabs May, Jemma injects her with a healing formula and freezes her in a cryo chamber to keep her alive.

changes.evidence: In S6#12 Sarge stabs May through the stomach and pushes her through the portal; she kills Izel in S6#13 and collapses. Simmons injects her and puts her in the cryo chamber. Izel only cuts her in their sword fight. Izel is not the one who fatally wounds her.

now.title: Agent Carter S2#4
now.text: After Peggy Carter kidnaps Rufus Hunt, she and Daniel Sousa interrogate him in secret. Hunt refuses to give up any names and mocks Daniel's missing leg.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A prisoner Sousa interrogates, who mocks his missing leg.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who interrogates Hunt in secret, whose leg Hunt mocks.

proposed.text: After Peggy Carter kidnaps Rufus Hunt, she and Daniel Sousa interrogate him in secret, and he mocks Daniel's missing leg. Tricked into thinking he has malaria, Hunt gives up Council names, and Daniel lets him escape with a bug on him.

changes.evidence: In Agent Carter S2#4 'Smoke & Mirrors' Hunt mocks Sousa's leg and boasts he cannot be broken, but after Peggy's fake malaria injection he names Thomas Gloucester and Hugh Jones and tells them about the Arena Club tapes. Sousa then lets him escape while bugged. 'Refuses to give up any names' is wrong.

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#47
now.text: Storm freezes Omega Red with a blizzard and later dives with him to a sinking submarine.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Storm freezes him with a blizzard.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Freezes Omega Red with a blizzard.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#17
proposed.text: In Russia, Storm whips up a blizzard to freeze Omega Red solid.

changes.evidence: Storm freezes Omega Red with a blizzard in #17 'Red Dawn'. The submarine dive is #47 'A Deal with the Devil'. The stage starts where its first fact holds (#17), so the #47 dive comes out of the text: it is a later event and could be its own stage. The card lines stay true.

now.title: Daredevil S3#10
now.text: Benjamin Poindexter, the hitman Bullseye, hunts Karen for Fisk. He attacks the New York Bulletin and Clinton Church trying to kill her.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Poindexter's target, whom he hunts for Fisk.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The hitman who hunts Karen for Fisk.

proposed.text: Benjamin Poindexter, the hitman Bullseye, hunts Karen for Fisk. Dressed as Daredevil, he attacks Clinton Church to kill her, but she knocks him off a balcony.

changes.evidence: At the Bulletin in S3#6 Dex points the gun at Karen but shoots Jasper Evans and leaves her alive; that was not an attempt on her life. Fisk orders Karen's death after she admits killing Wesley, and in S3#10 'Karen' Dex attacks Clinton Church to kill her. Karen knocks him off the balcony and he escapes.

now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#48
now.text: Terri Lee teams with Blade and Spider-Man against Morbius and falls for Blade, but they decide a relationship would be too dangerous. They share a last kiss before he leaves to hunt Miriam.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The vampire hunter Terri falls for.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The detective who falls for Blade.

proposed.title: Spider-Man (1994)#23
proposed.text: Terri Lee teams with Blade and Spider-Man against Morbius and falls for Blade, but they decide a relationship would be too dangerous. They share a last kiss before he rides away.

changes.evidence: The team-up against Morbius, the romance and the goodbye kiss all happen in #23 (S2 ch. X 'The Immortal Vampire'), where Blade kisses Terri and leaves on his motorcycle. Miriam is first seen in #48 'The Vampire Queen', so 'leaves to hunt Miriam' is wrong at #23. In #48 Terri convinces Blade to fight his mother, which could be its own later stage.

owner_calls.question: Hand assigns Trip and Simmons to the Hub in S1#16, but the stage sits at S1#17, where her fake Hydra test happens. Keep it at #17, or add a S1#16 boss stage for the Hub assignment and keep only the test at #17?
options: Add a S1#16 stage (Hand puts Trip and Simmons to work at the Hub) and trim #17 to the test
owner_calls.evidence: Hand orders Simmons and Triplett to work within the Hub as consultants on Deathlok (AoS116 'End of the Beginning'). The fake Hydra standoff is AoS117 'Turn, Turn, Turn'. Every fact in the stage is true.

owner_calls.question: Andrew counsels Jemma in S3#3-4, but the stage sits at S3#10, where she lets Lash out at the Hydra castle. Keep it at #10, or add a S3#4 stage for the counseling?
options: Add a S3#4 stage (Andrew counsels Jemma after her return) and keep #10 for the release
owner_calls.evidence: Coulson calls Garner in to assess Simmons in AoS303, and their session is in AoS304 'Devils You Know'. She opens his containment module in AoS310 'Maveth'. Every fact in the stage is true.
